decisions.statement: The compiler is run once per addon.
An addon's own compiler settings say which game globals the addon may name.
A declaration a sibling addon has is out of scope for the addon compiled.
The addons are taken in canonical-name order.
The first addon that does not typecheck ends the run.
An addon whose own files the compile leaves unread refuses the run.
An addon naming no bundle entry is reported as compiled of nothing.
An addon whose settings cannot be written refuses the run by name.
The whole run is bounded rather than each addon.
A run passing its ceiling refuses with the addon that run was on.
Nothing is emitted by the compiler here.
A run that refused names in that refusal every settings file it had written.
A run that wrote nothing says nothing about what it wrote.
The judging of the addons is handed in.

definition: the command typechecking each addon against its own compiler settings with nothing emitted
